phases.description: Port the 784-line Python CLI to a pure TypeScript core (injected config + ccusage runner; renderers return strings; CLI/MCP/service become thin consumers). Day-1 release gate: exact IEEE-754 money formatter matching Python half-even (Intl and toFixed are both proven wrong — see L-001). Parity = byte-frozen modulo a PUBLISHED delta allowlist, enforced by a dual-run harness comparing stdout+stderr+exit codes across the fixture matrix. Pin ccusage exact-version with real-binary schema contract tests. Exit: parity harness green; script-disabled installs work on npm+pnpm+yarn+bun; spendbar 0.1 published (NO author field). Reference: product-architecture-2026-07-30.md.
phases.label: V0.1
phases.name: v0.1 — TS core + CLI parity
phases.summary: TypeScript port of usage.py, byte-parity modulo published allowlist, publish spendbar 0.1

phases.description: Headless `spendbar service run` = sole snapshot writer, shipped WITH minimal durable install/start/stop + launcher (short-lived-command handoff test). Day-1 prototype gates: locking primitive, socket credential check, MCP SDK v2-vs-v1 against both real clients. Generation-file snapshot store with fsync protocol and schema-range/downgrade policy. Two-tier refresh (clone-shadow fast tier with formalized merge contract; capped full tier — honest periodic 60–80 s scans). 5 MCP tools (usage_hourly deferred), snapshot-timezone-match rule, generation-encoded cursors. Exit: week-per-project < 2 s warm from BOTH clients; herd test passes. Reference: product-architecture-2026-07-30.md.
phases.label: V0.2
phases.name: v0.2 — Headless service + MCP
phases.summary: Sole-writer refresh service with durable start/stop, snapshot store, 5 bounded MCP tools

phases.description: Productionize the proven 112 KB Swift NSStatusItem helper (title modes $ + burn with overflow contract, NSMenu dropdown, stdio IPC hardening, crash-loop breaker). Menubar host attaches to the service (Quit-menubar ≠ Stop-service). LaunchAgent through the launcher shim with installation-ID ownership; full upgrade matrix (upgrade/downgrade/prefix change/nvm removal/interrupted install, incl. real Claude Code + Codex MCP launches). D4 go/no-go: signed/notarized artifact prototype (Developer ID $99/yr — owner confirm). Bare-spendbar first-run wizard, doctor, ownership-fingerprinted uninstall. Exit: live $ ≤ 2 s; idle CPU ≈ 0; survives service restarts and package upgrades post-heal.
phases.label: V0.3
phases.name: v0.3 — Menubar
phases.summary: Swift menubar view on the service, LaunchAgent via launcher shim, D4 signing go/no-go, wizard onboarding

Settings (launch-at-login, refresh interval, title mode picker), health/stale UI states, passive update-notifier line (never self-mutating updates).
